title: Townsend Brown fired by the Navy, moves to Martin Vega before Skunk Works
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Townsend Brown fired by the Navy, moves to Martin Vega before Skunk Works, about 1942 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1942 the US Navy fired the inventor Townsend Brown without giving a reason. Michels says Brown then mysteriously turned up at the Martin Vega Corporation, an aircraft company, a year before Skunk Works, a famous secret aircraft design unit, was formed. He tells it because, if true, Brown's work may have quietly fed into secret aircraft projects.
